subject: math
description: Find and use scale factors between similar polygons to solve missing-side problems.
learningObjectives: Identify corresponding sides in similar polygons
Find a scale factor from a pair of corresponding side lengths
Use a scale factor to solve for missing side lengths
Distinguish enlargement scale factors from reduction scale factors
Describe how scale factor affects perimeter and area
prerequisites: Match corresponding vertices and sides in polygons
Understand that similar figures have equal angle measures and proportional side lengths
